pr_title: sql: sequences created for identity columns have incorrect types
pr_body:
Previously, when a sequence was created for an identity column, the type was not correctly propagated. This would cause those sequences to always be as of type Int. This behaviour was incorrect; they should match the type based on the column. To address, this patch will propagate the type into the sequence option.

Fixes: #110352

Release note (bug fix): CREATE TABLE with IDENTITY columns did not properly propagate the type of the column into the sequence.

issue_context.title: sql: incorrect sequence type and max value created for Identity column
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

Given a table created using the following SQL

```
CREATE TABLE public."People" (
  "Id" INT4 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
  "SomeColumn" INT4 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
  CONSTRAINT "PK_People" PRIMARY KEY ("Id" ASC)
)
```



```
SELECT
  sequence_schema, sequence_name,
  data_type AS seqtype,
  start_value::bigint AS seqstart,
  minimum_value::bigint AS seqmin,
  maximum_value::bigint AS seqmax,
  increment::bigint AS seqincrement,
  1::bigint AS seqcache,
  CASE
    WHEN cycle_option = 'YES' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS seqcycle
FROM information_schema.sequences
JOIN pg_namespace AS ns ON ns.nspname = sequence_schema
JOIN pg_class AS cls ON cls.relnamespace = ns.oid AND cls.relname = sequence_name;

```

the sequence that backs the Id column is as follows

```
  sequence_schema |     sequence_name     | seqtype | seqstart | seqmin |   seqmax   | seqincrement | seqcache | seqcycle
------------------+-----------------------+---------+----------+--------+------------+--------------+----------+-----------
  public          | People_SomeColumn_seq | INT8    |        1 |      1 | 2147483647 |            1 |        1 |    f
  public          | People_Id_seq         | INT8    |        1 |      1 | 2147483647 |            1 |        1 |    f
```

Issues:

- The sequence type INT8 while Id column is INT4
- The seqmax only 2147483647 (= max int 32)

**Additional context**
What was the impact?

This affects efcore.pg tests

@fqazi 


Jira issue: CRDB-31394
